title: Customer Agreement — Cancellation
text: Cancellation requires 30 days notice before the requested termination date.

title: Customer Agreement — Renewal
text: The agreement renews automatically for successive 12 month terms unless either party gives 60 days notice.

title: Billing Policy — Refunds
text: Approved refunds are processed within 10 business days after review is completed.

title: Billing Policy — Payment Terms
text: Invoices are due within 30 calendar days of the invoice date.

title: Security Standard — Log Retention
text: Production security logs must be retained for 365 days.

title: Security Standard — Session Timeout
text: Administrative web sessions expire after 15 minutes of inactivity.

title: Support SLA — Critical Incident
text: Priority 1 incidents have a 15 minute initial response objective.

title: Support SLA — Standard Incident
text: Priority 3 incidents have a 4 business hour initial response objective.
